subtitle: 圆梦收官
summary: A24《艾尔登法环》电影已正式杀青，计划于2028年3月3日上映。最新曝光的片场照暗示故事或发生在游戏之前，探索交界地遭破碎战争重创前的生活。
opus_summary: A24《艾尔登法环》电影已正式杀青，计划于2028年3月3日上映。最新曝光的片场照暗示故事或发生在游戏之前，探索交界地遭破碎战争重创前的生活。

paragraphs.en: Production has officially wrapped for A24’s Elden Ring movie , as revealed in a now-deleted Instagram post from prop artist Sean Schofield.
paragraphs.cn: 据道具师Sean Schofield一则现已删除的Instagram帖文透露，A24的《艾尔登法环》电影已正式杀青。

paragraphs.en: Schofield shared a photo of a special message celebrating the project from director Alex Garland, as well as producers Allon Reich, Matthew Penry-Davey, Peter Rice, Andrew Macdonald, and Charlie Reed.
paragraphs.cn: Schofield分享了一张照片，照片中有导演Alex Garland以及制片人Allon Reich、Matthew Penry-Davey、Peter Rice、Andrew Macdonald和Charlie Reed写给剧组、庆祝项目完成的特别致辞。

paragraphs.en: “Dear cast and crew, thank you for your incredibly hard work on Elden Ring. Your skill, dedication, and all-round professionalism were integral in bringing this unique project to life. We wish you a well-earned rest. Thank you and very best wishes, Alex, Allon, Matthew, Peter, Andrew and Charlie,” the message reads.
paragraphs.cn: 「致全体演员和剧组：感谢你们为《艾尔登法环》付出的辛勤努力。你们的技艺、投入和全面的专业素养，是让这个独特项目得以实现不可或缺的因素。祝各位好好休息。再次致谢，并致以最诚挚的祝福。Alex、Allon、Matthew、Peter、Andrew、Charlie。」致辞写道。

paragraphs.en: The photo shows the small message sitting on top of an Elden Ring-branded backpack and a keychain with a clapboard, which were likely given as gifts to crew working on the film.
paragraphs.cn: 照片显示，这张小纸条放在一个印有《艾尔登法环》标志的背包和一个带场记板的钥匙扣上，它们很可能是送给参与影片制作的剧组人员的礼物。

paragraphs.en: "Dream job to end all dream jobs," Schofield wrote in the post’s caption. "Six solid months of blood, sweat and tears making the coolest stuff ever, working alongside the best of the best. Can’t share anything else for a very long time, but I couldn’t be more proud of what we did."
paragraphs.cn: 「梦想工作中的梦想工作。」Schofield在帖文说明中写道，「整整六个月，我们挥洒血汗与泪水，和最顶尖的同行一起做着最酷的东西。很长一段时间都不能再分享其他内容，但我为我们完成的一切感到无比自豪。」

paragraphs.en: It seems that he may have shared this particular bit of news too early, as the post was taken down right in the middle of writing this article. You can't even find his profile right now, suggesting he made it private.
paragraphs.cn: 看来他可能太早分享了这条消息：就在本文写作期间，帖文被删除了。现在甚至找不到他的个人主页，这似乎表明他把主页设为了私密。

paragraphs.en: Production for the video game adaptation started in Spring 2026, with and is scheduled to release on March 3, 2028. That leaves over one year for post-production, which we can imagine will be quite demanding on the special effects team, given the not-insignificant amount of CGI that will likely be needed to bring George R. R. Martin and Miyazaki’s vision to life.
paragraphs.cn: 这部游戏改编电影于2026年春季开拍，计划于2028年3月3日上映。这给后期制作留下一年多时间；考虑到要将乔治·R·R·马丁和宫崎英高的构想呈现出来，可能需要相当可观的CGI，因此我们可以想见特效团队的工作将十分繁重。

paragraphs.en: This is the latest news to surface from the film after a series of set photos leaked online in April, shortly after production began, showing the execution of the Dung Eater and Queen Marika, played by Emma Laird. As noted by IGN’s own Wesley Yin-Poole, this hints that the events in the film will likely take place before the game, exploring what life was like before the Lands Between were wracked by The Shattering.
paragraphs.cn: 这是自4月一批片场照流出后的最新电影消息。那些照片在开拍不久后泄露，展示了食粪者以及由Emma Laird饰演的玛莉卡女王遭处刑的场景。正如IGN的Wesley Yin-Poole指出的，这暗示影片事件可能发生在游戏之前，探索交界地遭破碎战争重创前的生活。

paragraphs.en: Other information gleaned from the photos strongly suggested that the Royal Capital city of Leyndell will make an appearance in the movie, as could Stormveil Castle, thanks to labels plastered atop boxes on set. Props were also spotted that hint the Academy of Raya Lucaria will somehow get worked in.
paragraphs.cn: 从照片中获得的其他信息强烈表明，王城罗德尔将出现在电影中；片场箱子上的标签也暗示史东薇尔城可能亮相。此外，现场还发现了暗示雷亚卢卡利亚学院会以某种方式被纳入影片的道具。

paragraphs.en: A24’s Elden Ring cast includes stars like Nick Offerman, Havana Rose Liu, Jonathan Pryce, Peter Serafinowicz, Cailee Spaeny, with a reported budget of more than $100 million . The arthouse studio is sparing no expense for this flick, and we can't wait to see how they tackle the Lands Between come March 2028.
paragraphs.cn: A24的《艾尔登法环》演员阵容包括尼克·奥弗曼、Havana Rose Liu、乔纳森·普雷斯、Peter Serafinowicz和卡莉·史派妮等，据称预算超过1亿美元(约合人民币7亿元)。这家艺术电影工作室在本片上不惜成本，我们迫不及待想看看他们会如何在2028年3月呈现交界地。
